title: Plane geometry of $q$-rationals and Springborn Operations
summary: We study the geometry of $q$-rational numbers, introduced by Morier-Genoud and Ovsienko, for positive real $q$. In particular, we construct and analyse the deformed Farey triangulation and the deformed modular surface. We interpret every $q$-rational geometrically as a circle, similar to the famous Ford circles. Further, we define and study new operations on $q$-rationals, the Springborn operations, which can be seen as a quadratic version of the Farey addition.
